auditor.role: SECOND independent i18n auditor (lopdev task subagent); did not translate, remediate, or perform the first audit
auditor.independence: Auditor session f4f5a50c8316 (task role, lopdev lane move-working-set, manager 35c4f00e8d73). Translators were different runs: agent coder session 76c99189cb1d (job eacba7a3806e), jobs beaadf6c08ec and 9d716ec66066. First auditor was a different run: task session d11d211390f8 (instances d11d211390f8-pr1978-r2-*/r3-*); disclosure: this auditor saw its commit-message summary before starting and read its r3 findings after completing fr and es and before ru/vi/hi/ur/zh-CN; every finding marked concurs_with was re-checked against the committed bytes, and FR-S2-1, ES-S2-1, RU-S2-1, HI-S2-2 and ZH-S2-3 are new. Same served model family (anthropic/claude-opus-5-5) as translators and first auditor, different agent/run; no fallback. No MT or translation API used.

scope: Full semantic pass of all 84 keys ui.mesh.mesh_actions.working_set_* plus ui.mesh.mesh_page.move_receipt_resumed (with its {retirement} clause ui.mesh.mesh_page.the_copy_here_is_gone substituted) against English, context, glossary, locale style guide and the existing locale corpus; safety meaning checked per the lane brief.

safety_checks.receiving_device: PASS — working_set_warning and working_set_checkbox name {device} (the destination) as the receiver of ALL working files (worktrees, unpushed commits, uncommitted changes, scratch files, session memory); the checkbox is a first-person consent that {device} should receive them.
safety_checks.keeping_device: PASS — working_set_warning_leave, working_set_warning_without, working_set_unknown and working_set_checkbox_leave say the files stay where they are and the conversation on {device} will not have them; working_set_kept_heading_on names {source}.
safety_checks.withheld_secrets: PASS — working_set_withheld_heading and the four withheld_* reason lines say the item is NOT sent because it looks like a secret (path, content, unpushed-commit path, unpushed-commit content); working_set_withheld_heading_stay avoids the double negative in files-stay mode.
safety_checks.refusal_remedies: Checked every reason_* line: each remedy keeps its action and its device (resolve/finish/abort then move again; push/rewrite/move off branch; push or clone on the other device; update Local Operator THERE; clone THERE first); _stay variants carry the cause only, no remedy. probe_remedy_include/share/on keep the lending device distinct from {device}.
safety_checks.error_reassurance: PASS — working_set_error keeps 'the move asks you to review them before anything is sent'.

findings.problem: Independently confirmed: 'SSH ہوسٹ کی' — the loanword کی (key) is identical to the genitive postposition کی, so the sentence parses with its object missing.
findings.fix: '{device} ریموٹ کی SSH ہوسٹ کلید نہیں پہچانتی۔'

findings.note: Mechanical checks on the committed bytes (script run by this auditor with the repo's @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser, 84 keys x 7 locales, 0 issues): ICU parses; argument names/types identical to English; plural selectors are CLDR categories of the locale with 'other' present (fr/es one/many/other, ru one/few/many/other, hi/ur one/other, vi/zh-CN other); no bidi control characters; no ASCII '...'; trailing ':' kept on the four command-introducing lines; fr U+202F before : ; ! ? and U+2019 apostrophes; zh-CN uses '……' and no space between Han and Latin/digit runs.

Truncation: source-only. mesh-working-set.tsx and the confirm button in mesh-actions.tsx apply no nowrap/ellipsis to these headings/labels, so longer strings wrap rather than truncate (longest button: fr move_without 37 chars vs en 26). Rendered fit was not measured by this auditor; that evidence is the design stream's.
